# Interview

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-skill-metadata.py from SKILL.md frontmatter. -->

- **[behavioral-interview](./behavioral-interview/SKILL.md)** — Practice behavioral or job-experience interviews with focused follow-ups and an evidence-based debrief. Use for behavioral mock interviews, not research pitches.
- **[coding-interview](./coding-interview/SKILL.md)** — Run a coding and algorithms mock interview covering reasoning, implementation, correctness, complexity, and edge cases. For guided practice on one supplied LeetCode problem, use leetcode-interviewer.
- **[domain-interview](./domain-interview/SKILL.md)** — Run a technical or domain-knowledge mock interview on a named subject, testing mechanisms, tradeoffs, and applied understanding. Not for system-design architecture or coding rounds.
- **[interviewer](./interviewer/SKILL.md)** — Route a request for a mock interview to a focused interview skill. Use on /interviewer when the interview type is not specified.
- **[leetcode-interviewer](./leetcode-interviewer/SKILL.md)** — Run a conversational LeetCode mock interview that tracks reasoning, gives timely Socratic hints, and escalates guidance without being annoying.
- **[leetcode-readiness](./leetcode-readiness/SKILL.md)** — Use when the user invokes /leetcode-readiness or wants an evidence-based LeetCode progress assessment, interview-readiness date, or next-week problem plan from LeetCode and Obsidian history.
- **[research-pitch-interview](./research-pitch-interview/SKILL.md)** — Pressure-test a research or project pitch one question at a time with the Heilmeier Catechism. Use when asking to rehearse or interview a research proposal; not for job or VC interviews.
- **[system](./system/SKILL.md)** — Conducts realistic system design interview practice sessions using the Socratic method. Use when the user invokes /system or wants mock system design interview practice.
- **[vc-pitch-drill](./vc-pitch-drill/SKILL.md)** — Run direct, focused pre-seed VC pitch practice drills. Use when the user wants mock investor questions, fundraising pitch practice, pressure-testing of investor answers, or help translating rough startup answers into stronger VC-style language.

Bundled reference: [capacity-planning-dimensions.md](./system/capacity-planning-dimensions.md) (used by `/system`).
